<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:1:23">Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:4:3">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>תמן חשין לצ׳ רבה תרין יומין</he> there (in Babylonia) were such as thought the Great Fast (Day of Atonement) should be observed two days (on account of the uncertainty of the calendar).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:1:11">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דאת מחשב ואת משכח צ׳ רבה וכ׳</he> for if you make the calculation, you will find that the Day of Atonement would have been on a Sunday (which must not be); a. fr.—Pl. <he>צוֹמִין</he>, <he>צוֹמַיָּא</he>, <he>צוֹמָתָא</he>.
